items.summary_en: Imagine finding a family's home videos from the 1950s in your new house. That's the somewhat unsettling situation TikTok creator @saraheposts finds herself in after a relative dug out an old VHS tape while mooching through some cabinets before she moved in. Opening up about this discovery in her 'haunted' Maine residence, she told her social media followers in a recent video : "I promised that I would show the creepiest thing in this house and I'll clarify that that does not include the attic.
